notes.title: Next stage goal
notes.notes:
I have completed my ideas for the previous stage, attempting to enrich the game experience through storylines and random maps. However, it seems that the game content is still not at a stage where it can be released online.
In the next phase of work, I want to focus more on developing the combinations of game items, rather than just tweaking numerical values. To keep myself on track, I am making this commitment now to prevent my development direction from deviating.
Additionally, I plan to increase the variety of attack methods for small enemies in the game.

[list]
[*] Added story system
[*] Added Workshop
[*] Redesigned building system
[*] Added game node-based maps
[*] Added various weapons
[*] Added various cards
[/list]

notes.title: A new version is now under development
notes.notes:
I seem to have not updated for a while, because I developed a new node level map, which allows players to choose their own routes, but some work has not been completed
At the same time, the balance of weapons and some achievement systems seem to make players feel repetitive work, which is not what I want. For this reason, I am still considering the plot system. The development cycle of one person may be a bit long, but the latest development progress will be disclosed on self-media at each stage
If there are any problems with the current game, please be sure to contact the developer, your criticism and feedback are the greatest spiritual support

Dear Players,

I hope this message finds you well. I am reaching out to share some important updates regarding the upcoming changes to the construction system in my game.

After thoughtful consideration and taking into account the feedback from our community, I have decided to overhaul the construction system to enhance the enjoyment and satisfaction you experience while building and strategizing within the game. My goal is to ensure that the construction aspect of the game is not only engaging but also provides a sense of accomplishment and fun.

To achieve this, I will be dedicating time to thoroughly rewrite and refine the system. This process will involve extensive testing and iteration to ensure that the new system meets my high standards and exceeds your expectations.

As a result, I regret to inform you that the pace of future updates will be slower than initially planned. I understand that this may be disappointing, but I believe that taking the time to get this right is crucial for the long-term enjoyment and success of my game.

I am committed to delivering a game that you love and are proud to play. I appreciate your patience and understanding as I work diligently to improve your gaming experience.

Thank you for your continued support. I look forward to sharing more details about the new construction system and other exciting updates in the near future.

Warm regards,
